title: Vintage Le Creuset Fondue Bourguignonne Set 6420 – Complete Set – Made in France
description:
Beautiful and complete vintage Le Creuset “Fondue Bourguignonne” set, made in France, with its original box and accessories. A wonderful collectible set combining classic French design with the quality and durability of vintage Le Creuset craftsmanship.
This lovely set includes the enamelled fondue pot with lid and elegant blue floral decor, the cast iron burner stand, metal safety grill, wooden serving tray marked Le Creuset, 6 original fondue forks with wooden handles, the original instruction leaflet and recipe booklet, as well as the original Le Creuset box.
Overall, the set is in very good vintage condition with light signs of age and use consistent with time. The original box shows some storage wear.
A rare and decorative complete Le Creuset set, perfect for collectors, cozy fondue evenings, or as a beautiful display piece in a vintage kitchen.
As all my articles are vintage, please check pictures carefully for condition details.
